info.title: Solace API
info.description: The Solace calendar and mail API.

delete.summary: Deletes the caller's account with its Stalwart mailbox and stored avatar; any body or query is ignored.

get.summary: Whether the caller is signed in and still owes a passkey step-up; never cached.
Normalizes the chosen handle or address to the Solace domain and says whether it can be used.

post.summary: Links an invite to the chosen Solace address; sign-up must follow within 15 minutes.

get.summary: Checks an invite token before sign-up; 30 requests a minute per client.
The Solace domain new accounts choose their address in.
The session and user behind the cookie, or null; renews sessions older than a day.
The caller's calendars, default first, then by name.

post.summary: Stores the client-encrypted starting calendars when the caller owns none yet; answers the caller's calendars either way.

delete.summary: Deletes an owned calendar, deleting its events (default) or moving them to another calendar.

get.summary: The caller's active categories by name, each with how many events use it.

delete.summary: Deletes the category and clears it from the caller's events.

get.summary: The caller's devices, password envelope and calendars, for unlocking on a device.

put.summary: Registers or refreshes this device's wrapping public key and the account keys wrapped to it.

delete.summary: Removes one of the caller's devices by its client-chosen id, as signing out on it does; another user's id is not found.

404.description: No such device for the caller

put.summary: Stores or rotates the password-wrapped account keys used to unlock a new device.

get.summary: Raw owned calendars, active categories and unsynced events, so a client can re-wrap them on password reset.
The caller's events in a range, with recurring instances, categories and calendars.

post.summary: Moves, deletes or duplicates several events at once.

get.summary: The local copy of a mailed invitation by its UID, or `null`.

post.summary: Declines a mailed invitation without importing it: replies to the organizer and keeps a hidden declined copy.
Imports a decrypted mailed invitation: staged in the hidden Invitations calendar, or accepted onto a writable one.

get.summary: Plaintext full-text search, with blind-index tokens for encrypted events.
Pages of the caller's events with their ciphertext, for device-local search indexing.

put.summary: Updates the event; an instance id edits its series, and a stale `updatedAt` is refused.

post.summary: Answers a mailed invitation; a decline hides the copy and answers `{ deleted: true }`.
Stores ciphertext for an imported invitation without changing its schedule.

get.summary: Liveness probe for uptime checks and deploys.
One unauthenticated request to Stalwart's JMAP discovery; 503 when the API cannot reach the mail server.

post.summary: Accepts signed Stalwart `message-ingest.ham` events and queues native pushes for linked Solace mailboxes.

get.summary: The caller's invites, newest first.

post.summary: Invites someone outside Solace and mails them the link; a failed mail is a warning, not an error.

delete.summary: Revokes one of the caller's invites unless it was already accepted.

get.summary: The caller's encrypted mail settings, or `null` before the first upload.

put.summary: Stores or replaces the caller's blob; an omitted key version keeps the stored one.

get.summary: Whether the caller's Solace account has a linked mailbox, and its address.

post.summary: Provisions the caller's mailbox with the client-made OpenPGP key, encryption at rest and the sealed vault backup.

get.summary: The caller's encrypted private-key vault backup.

put.summary: Replaces the caller's ciphertext-only vault backup.

get.summary: The public mail configuration: domain, JMAP discovery base, token endpoint and Stalwart's limits.
A mailbox's OpenPGP public key; signed-in callers also get keys only Stalwart still holds. 60 a minute per user or client.
A Stalwart bearer for the caller's own mailbox, minted server-side; refused while the session still needs passkey step-up.
JMAP Email, Mailbox and Thread changes for the caller's own mailbox, read with server-side credentials.
The session user, or `{ user: null }` without a session.

put.summary: Replaces the event's reminders; the earliest enabled email reminder becomes the event's `reminder`.

get.summary: Streams the smallest stored WebP variant covering `size` pixels (default 512) while the id is attached to an account.

post.summary: Avatar paths for Solace users with a usable picture, in request order.

put.summary: Stores the caller's square crop as WebP variants (32–512px) and retires the previous picture.

delete.summary: Removes the caller's picture and deletes its stored variants.

get.summary: The caller's enabled devices, most recently seen first; tokens never leave the server.

put.summary: Stores or refreshes an APNs token; it moves to the caller if another user had it.

delete.summary: Deletes one of the caller's tokens, or every device without one.

post.summary: Queues a metadata-only reminder push to the caller's devices.

get.summary: Signals that the caller's mailbox changed, with the synced deltas.
The caller's encrypted recent contacts, or `null` before the first upload.

put.summary: Stores or replaces the caller's blob; an omitted key version keeps the stored one.
Edits one occurrence (detached), this and future occurrences (a split), or the whole series.

delete.summary: Deletes one occurrence (an exception), this and future occurrences (ends the rule), or the series with its children.

get.summary: The six fixed patterns the editors offer.

post.summary: The occurrences of a rule from the start through `previewDays` (90 by default) later.
Validates a rule object or rule text and describes it.

get.summary: The caller's settings, created with the defaults if none exist.

put.summary: Updates the given settings; choosing an encryption mode turns off calendar share links.

delete.summary: Deletes the caller's settings, so the next read starts from the defaults.

get.summary: The caller's feeds, newest first, with their calendars and sync log counts.

post.summary: Subscribes to a feed that answers, in a new read-only calendar, and syncs it in the background.
Imports client-encrypted events into an owned calendar.

put.summary: Renames, recolors, pauses or re-times a feed; name and color also change its calendar.

delete.summary: Deletes a feed; `deleteEvents=true` also deletes its events and calendar, otherwise both become the owner's.

post.summary: Syncs a feed now, paused or not; a failed fetch is recorded and answered as an error.

get.summary: Confirms request routing and shows the server time.
The session user; 401 without a session.

AuthError.description: Better Auth's error body: a message and a machine-readable code.

AuthSession.description: A session row; the client IP and user agent are never stored, so both are always null.

AuthUser.description: The user as Better Auth returns it: core fields only.

AvatarSizeQuery.description: Query of `GET /api/profiles/avatars/:avatarId`; `size` is rounded up to a stored variant.

blindIndexTokens.description: A JSON array of blind-index tokens, stored as text.

name.description: Empty when the name is encrypted.

CalendarSubscription.description: A feed subscription with its mirrored calendar; only the list carries `_count`.

blindIndexTokens.description: A JSON array of blind-index tokens, stored as text.

name.description: Empty when the name is encrypted.

invitationContent.description: Transient plaintext for invitation mail; never stored.

reminder.description: Minutes before the start, or `null` for none.

occurrenceDate.description: The occurrence instant; required for `this_only` and `this_and_future`.

DeleteSubscriptionQuery.description: Query of `DELETE /api/subscriptions/:id`; `true` also deletes the synced events and calendar.

enabled.description: Always true; shipped native binaries reject a bootstrap without it.

occurrenceDate.description: The occurrence instant; required for `this_only` and `this_and_future`.

recurrence.description: A recurrence rule object as JSON text.

seriesExternalId.description: Set on an override, together with `occurrenceDate`.

EncryptedIcsImportRequest.description: `POST /api/subscriptions/import-ics`: events the client parsed and encrypted.

blindIndexTokens.description: Parsed from the stored JSON; unreadable values become an empty list.

EncryptionDevice.description: A device's public key and the account keys wrapped to it, stored as the client sent them (trimmed).

ErrorResponse.description: The `lib/errors.ts` envelope; `requestId` is absent on the auth guard's 401/403.

Event.description: A `calendar_event` row with its relations, as create, read, update and list return it.

blindIndexTokens.description: A JSON array of blind-index tokens, stored as text.

id.description: A recurring instance in a list is `<seriesId>_<occurrence ISO instant>`.

isRecurringInstance.description: Set on recurring series rows in a list: `false` for the series row itself, `true` for generated instances.

participants.description: Absent only on whole-series recurring edits that carry no participants.

recurrence.description: A JSON recurrence rule, stored as text.

recurrenceExceptions.description: Present on recurring series rows and their instances in a list.

title.description: Empty for encrypted events: the content lives in `encryptedContent`.

EventCalendar.description: The full `calendar` row an event embeds.

EventCategory.description: The full `event_category` row an event embeds.

events.description: Regular events, recurring series and instances, and detached occurrences, by start.

image.description: A Solace avatar path (`/api/profiles/avatars/:id`), never a remote URL.

oneOf.description: The Solace user behind the address, when there is one.

EventSearchCorpusQuery.description: `GET /api/events/search-corpus`: pages of the owner's events for on-device indexing.

readableInvitations.description: Only invitation copies still stored readable, declined ones included, for the device to seal.

EventSearchQuery.description: `GET /api/events/search`: plaintext `q`, or comma-separated blind-index tokens for encrypted events.

errors.description: Per-event problems; absent when there were none.

ImportInvitationRequest.description: A decrypted mailed invitation the client imports.

status.description: `accepted` or `tentative`; without it the invitation is staged.

InvitationImportSummary.description: What an ICS invitation import did.

warnings.description: Present only when the invite mail could not be delivered.

InviteClaimResult.description: `POST /api/account/invite/claim`: the claimed invite, or why it cannot be claimed.

InviteValidation.description: `GET /api/account/invite/validate`: whether a token can still be used to sign up.

MailAccessToken.description: `GET /api/mail/oauth/access-token`: a Stalwart bearer; the wire keeps OAuth's snake_case.

MailAccountId.description: A Stalwart account id, which is also the JMAP `accountId`.

MailBootstrapRequest.description: `POST /api/mail/account/bootstrap`; the mailbox address is the session user's email.

MailCalendarImportSummary.description: What invitation auto-filing did with the ICS parts it found; also the answer of `POST /api/events/invitations/import-ics`.

oneOf.description: Null when Stalwart's limits could not be read.

MailServerLimits.description: Stalwart's Email and Jmap singleton limits; a field is absent when Stalwart did not report it.

MailSignup.description: The provisioned mailbox returned by bootstrap.

MailSyncCollection.description: One JMAP type's changes; `records` are Stalwart's objects passed through.

MailSyncResult.description: `GET /api/mail/sync`: JMAP deltas since the stored state, plus the invitation import they triggered.

initialized.description: True when this call stored the first JMAP state for the mailbox.

MailVaultBackupRequest.description: `PUT /api/mail/account/vault-backup`; an omitted or null seal keeps the stored one.

wrappedSecret.description: Absent keeps the stored seal; a vault is never left unsealed.

MailVaultKdfParams.description: Argon2id parameters of the encrypted private-key vault.

MeResponse.description: `GET /api/me`: the session user, or null without a session.

deletedCount.description: Only on the no-op answer for recurring instances and synced events.

data.description: Absent for recurring instances and synced events, which have no reminders.

OperationWarning.description: A non-fatal problem attached to a successful mutation, such as an invite mail that could not be delivered.

Passkey.description: A passkey row as the passkey plugin returns it: the COSE key in standard base64, the credential id in base64url.

previewDays.description: 7 to 365 days from the start; 90 when omitted.

encryptionKeyVersion.description: Defaults to 1 on the first upload and is kept when omitted later.
Defaults to 1 on the first upload and is kept when omitted later.

RecurrenceRule.description: The JSON object stored (as text) in `calendar_event.recurrence`.

RecurrenceRuleInput.description: A rule object, or the JSON text of one as events store it.

rule.description: The parsed rule as the input held it, extra keys included and an unreadable `until` as null; absent when it could not be parsed.

categoryId.description: An empty id clears the category.

reminder.description: Any number; stored truncated to whole minutes.

environment.description: `sandbox` or `production`; only the first registration's value is kept.

ResetSnapshot.description: Raw owned calendars, active categories and unsynced events, so a client can re-wrap them on password reset.

RsvpResult.description: A decline answers `{ deleted: true }`; accept and tentative answer the updated event.

SearchEvent.description: A search hit: a subset of the row with trimmed calendar and category.

SeedDefaultCalendarsRequest.description: `POST /api/calendars/defaults`: the client-encrypted starting calendars of an account that owns none yet.

SolaceProfile.description: A Solace user with a picture: the normalized email and an API-relative avatar path.

StalwartWebhookError.description: The webhook's refusals, which are not the API envelope.

StalwartWebhookResult.description: `POST /api/internal/stalwart/webhook`; `enqueuedCount` counts events handed to the push outbox, duplicates included.

SubscribedCalendar.description: The full calendar row behind a subscription, as stored.

blindIndexTokens.description: Raw stored JSON text, not a parsed list.

SubscriptionSyncResult.description: Answer of a manual sync; a failed fetch is an error envelope instead.

SuccessMessage.description: `{ success, message }`, the answer of most deletes and resets.

Timestamp.description: A UTC instant as JavaScript's `toISOString()` writes it: three fractional digits and `Z`.

UnregisterPushDeviceRequest.description: Without a token every device of the user is removed.

displayTitle.description: Binaries built before 2026-09-15 still send it; accepted and dropped, never stored.

encryptedDisplayTitle.description: `v1.<iv>.<ciphertext>` under the notification key; omitted keeps the stored one, `null` clears it.

categoryId.description: An empty id clears the category.

recurrence.description: `null` turns a series into a single event.

encryptedPreferences.description: Replaces the sealed preferences; their plaintext fields go back to the defaults and any sent with it are ignored.

workingDays.description: A JSON array of weekday numbers as text.

UploadAvatarRequest.description: A base64 square crop; the API stores only re-encoded WebP variants of it.

encryptedPreferences.description: App-only preferences sealed on the device; while set, their fields above hold the defaults.

workingDays.description: A JSON array of weekday numbers, stored as text.
